# The controls past the first slice, each a Win32 control the runtime makes
# and lays out. A multi-line edit holds its lines as "\r\n", which the
# program reads and writes as "\n", and commits its text as the focus leaves
# it. A drop-down is offered its choices by label and reports the one picked,
# which a test picks by the value it holds. A progress bar writes its text,
# or how far along it is, over itself, and one given no value is a marquee. A
# timer is a SetTimer of the window every node is made in, which the effect
# cancels as its branch goes.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c controls.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
exists controls.sngl.snapshots/controls.png

# A box lays its children out along its axis, in a grid's columns, in rows
# that wrap, one over another (the last on top), or in equal shares, and a
# card's draws an etched edge and is pressed as a button is. A node its
# style's display hides, or a drawer closed, takes no room. A link opens its
# href as the user clicks it, which a test's click does not, and a radio
# group's buttons are a box's, which Win32 unchecks the others of. A text is
# a static control that reports a click, as an avatar's initials are.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c layout.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
exists layout.sngl.snapshots/closed.png
exists layout.sngl.snapshots/open.png
! cmp layout.sngl.snapshots/closed.png layout.sngl.snapshots/open.png

# A tabs is a tab control holding a box per page, which shows the selected
# page's and refuses a disabled one's tab, and a test chooses a tab as a
# click does. A scroll is a box with scroll bars that moves what it holds,
# as tall as its style says, which reports its end showing as it arrives. A
# tooltip's box gives its trigger a tool of the shared tooltip. A modal is a
# window of its own over the program's, whose close button is the program's
# to answer.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c panels.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
exists panels.sngl.snapshots/first.png
exists panels.sngl.snapshots/more.png
! cmp panels.sngl.snapshots/first.png panels.sngl.snapshots/more.png

# A menu entry is a node taking no room, which the window it is in shows in
# its menu bar wherever in it it is -- the window's own menu and a
# ui.menubar's alike -- and an entry holding entries as their submenu. A
# command reaches the entry's handler by its id, and a test chooses one by
# its label as the user does, which a grayed one refuses. A ui.menu is its
# entries as buttons in place while it is open.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c menus.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
exists menus.sngl.snapshots/menu.png

# A table is a list view in report mode, offered its columns and rows as
# text whenever they change, each column as wide as its widest cell; a row
# the user selects and a header they click reach the program's handlers. A
# tree is a tree view offered its nodes indented a tab a level, those
# `expanded` lists expanded. A date picker's check box unchecked is no
# date, and a date crosses as its ISO text. A test picks each as the user
# does, through sngl:platform/win32's pickRow, clickColumn, pickNode and
# pickDate. The table's override formats each row's cells in a lambda,
# whose library copy of list.format is made after BuiltinMethods packed
# every other `_formatArgs`; AnonStructs packs it too.

sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c data.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
exists data.sngl.snapshots/data.png

# An image is a node holding a picture, which WIC decodes from a file the
# program carries (sngl_win32_assets.c, by the path its URL names under the
# root), from one fetched, or from one on disk, and which paints itself
# fitted into the image with its alpha. The image hears its picture load,
# or fail and why, once the picture is in it. A canvasImage paints the same
# file into its box through the canvas's GDI+ context, decoded once a
# canvas. The PNG is a red dot on a transparent ground, written at the start.

exec sh -c 'echo iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAYAAAAf8/9hAAAALElEQVR4nGNgGJ7ghIbGf1yYIs0EDSFGM15DRg0YDAYQawhOzcQYQlAz3QEA+63jzIuGVSkAAAAASUVORK5CYII= | base64 -d > logo.png'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c image.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
exists image.sngl.snapshots/logo.png
exists image.sngl.snapshots/canvas.png

# The same programs in Go, which calls the runtime through the wrappers
# `sngl tool cgogen` writes (lib/platform/win32/cgo) and serves its tests
# over TCP as C's agent does, draw what C's drew: each snapshot is held to
# the one the C run wrote.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go controls.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go layout.sngl
stdout 'ok +2 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go panels.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go menus.sngl
stdout 'ok +3 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go data.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=go image.sngl
stdout 'ok +4 tests, 0 failures'

-- controls.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import time "sngl:time"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        win32
    }
}

enum Fruit { apple, banana, cherry }

component main ui.node {
    var notes = "one\ntwo"
    var typed = ""
    var fruit = Fruit.banana
    var picked = 0
    var ticks = 0
    var running = true
    ui.vbox {
        ui.textarea #area(rows=3, value=notes, @input(v) { typed = v }, @change(v) { notes = v })
        ui.select #pick(:value=fruit, @change(v) { picked += 1 }) {
            for var f = Fruit {
                ui.choice(label="{f}", value=f)
            }
        }
        ui.progress(value=3, max=10, showValue=true)
        ui.progress(label="working", showValue=true)
        ui.text(value="{fruit} {ticks}")
        time.timer(interval=20ms, enabled=running, @tick { ticks += 1 })
        ui.checkbox #run(checked=running, @change(v) { running = v })
    }
}

ui.window(title="Controls") {
    main()
}

func testTextAreaLines(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.area.input("a\nb")
    t.assert(c.typed == "a\nb")
    t.assert(c.notes == "one\ntwo")
    c.area.change("a\nb\nc")
    t.assert(c.notes == "a\nb\nc")
}

func testSelectPicks(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.pick.change(Fruit.cherry)
    t.assert(c.fruit == Fruit.cherry)
    t.assert(c.picked == 1)
    c.pick.change(Fruit.cherry)
    t.assert(c.picked == 1)
}

func testTimerTicks(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.wait(func() => c.ticks >= 2, 2000)
    t.assert(c.ticks >= 2)
    c.run.change(false)
    var at = c.ticks
    t.wait(func() => false, 100)
    t.assert(c.ticks == at)
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("controls")
}
-- layout.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        win32
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var links = 0
    var cards = 0
    var taps = 0
    var size = 2
    var dark = false
    var open = false
    var hide = false
    ui.vbox {
        ui.toolbar {
            ui.button(text="Open", @click { open = !open })
            ui.link #site(text="Site", href="https://example.com", @click { links += 1 })
            ui.toggle #night(label="Dark", :checked=dark)
        }
        ui.divider()
        ui.grid(columns=3) {
            for var i = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] {
                ui.text(value="cell {i}")
            }
        }
        ui.grid {
            for var w = ["alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta", "epsilon", "zeta", "eta", "theta", "iota"] {
                ui.button(text=w)
            }
        }
        ui.splitview {
            ui.text(value="left")
            ui.text(value="right")
        }
        ui.card #panel(clickable=true, style={padding=8px}, @click { cards += 1 }) {
            ui.text(value="Card {cards}")
        }
        ui.radio #sizes(:value=size, direction=ui.Orientation.horizontal) {
            ui.choice(label="S", value=1)
            ui.choice(label="M", value=2)
            ui.choice(label="L", value=3)
        }
        ui.stack {
            ui.text(value="under")
            ui.text(value="over", style={display=hide ? ui.Display.none : ui.Display.flex})
        }
        ui.drawer(open=open) {
            component content {
                ui.text(value="drawer")
            }
        }
        ui.spinner()
        ui.hbox(style={gap=8px}) {
            ui.text #tap(value="size {size} dark {dark} taps {taps}", @click { taps += 1 })
            ui.avatar(initials="JD", @click { taps += 1 })
        }
    }
}

ui.window(title="Layout") {
    main()
}

func testEventsReachTheirHandlers(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.site.click()
    t.assert(c.links == 1)
    c.panel.click()
    t.assert(c.cards == 1)
    c.sizes.change(3)
    t.assert(c.size == 3)
    c.night.change(true)
    t.assert(c.dark)
    c.tap.click()
    t.assert(c.taps == 1)
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("closed")
    c.open = true
    c.hide = true
    t.snapshot("open")
}
-- panels.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"

output {
    c {
        win32
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var idx = 0
    var changed = -1
    var extra = false
    var rows = [1, 2, 3]
    var asked = 0
    var asking = false
    var closes = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.tabs #tabs(:selected=idx, @change(i) { changed = i }) {
            ui.tab(label="One") {
                ui.text(value="first panel")
            }
            ui.tab(label="Off", disabled=true) {
                ui.text(value="second panel")
            }
            if extra {
                ui.tab(label="More") {
                    ui.text(value="more panel")
                }
            }
        }
        ui.tooltip(text="Asks for a row") {
            ui.button(text="Ask", @click { asking = true })
        }
        ui.scroll #list(style={height=60px}, @reachEnd {
            asked += 1
            rows.push(asked + 3)
        }) {
            ui.vbox {
                for var r = rows {
                    ui.text(value="row {r}")
                }
            }
        }
        ui.modal #ask(open=asking, title="Ask", closable=true, @close {
            closes += 1
            asking = false
        }) {
            component content {
                ui.text(value="Another row?")
            }
        }
        ui.text(value="tab {idx} changed {changed} asked {asked}")
    }
}

ui.window(title="Panels") {
    main()
}

func testPressingATabSelectsIt(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.extra = true
    c.tabs.change(2)
    t.assert(c.idx == 2)
    t.assert(c.changed == 2)
    c.tabs.change(1)
    t.assert(c.idx == 2)
}

func testTheEndAsksForMore(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.list.reachEnd()
    t.assert(c.asked == 1)
    t.assert(c.rows.length() == 4)
}

func testAModalClosesThroughTheProgram(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.asking = true
    c.ask.close()
    t.assert(c.closes == 1)
    t.assert(!c.asking)
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("first")
    c.extra = true
    c.tabs.change(2)
    t.snapshot("more")
}
-- menus.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"
import win32 "sngl:platform/win32"

output {
    c {
        win32
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var opened = 0
    var wrap = false
    var showMenu = false
    var picks = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.menubar {
            ui.menuItem(label="File") {
                ui.menuItem(label="Open", @select { opened += 1 })
                ui.menuItem(label="Wrap", checked=wrap, @select { wrap = !wrap })
            }
            ui.menuItem(label="Help", disabled=true)
        }
        ui.button #more(text="More", @click { showMenu = !showMenu })
        ui.menu(open=showMenu) {
            ui.menuItem(label="Pick", @select { picks += 1 })
            ui.menuItem(label="Never", disabled=true)
        }
        ui.text #status(value="opened {opened} wrap {wrap} picks {picks}")
    }
}

ui.window(title="Menus") {
    main()
    component menu {
        ui.menuItem(label="Window") {
            ui.menuItem(label="Close")
        }
    }
}

func testTheWindowBuilds(t test.Test) {
    t.assert(true)
}

func testTheMenuBarIsTheWindows(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(win32.menuItems(c.status) == 2)
    t.assert(win32.chooseMenu(c.status, "Open"))
    t.assert(c.opened == 1)
    t.assert(win32.chooseMenu(c.status, "Wrap"))
    t.assert(c.wrap)
    t.assert(!win32.chooseMenu(c.status, "Help"))
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.snapshot("shut")
    c.more.click()
    t.snapshot("menu")
}
-- data.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"
import time "sngl:time"
import win32 "sngl:platform/win32"

output {
    c {
        win32
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var row = -1
    var picks = 0
    var sortedBy = ""
    var node = ""
    var expands = 0
    var day option[time.date] = null
    var seen = "none"
    ui.vbox {
        ui.table(columns=["Name", "Age"], selectable=true, sortable=true, :selected=row, @select { picks += 1 }, @sort(col) { sortedBy = col }) {
            ui.tableRow(cells=["Ann", "34"])
            ui.tableRow(cells=["Bob", "27"])
        }
        ui.tree(:selected=node, expanded=[0], @expand { expands += 1 }) {
            ui.treeItem(label="src") {
                ui.treeItem(label="main.sngl")
                ui.treeItem(label="lib") {
                    ui.treeItem(label="util.sngl")
                }
            }
            ui.treeItem(label="README")
        }
        ui.datepicker(:value=day, @change(v) { seen = v == null ? "no day" : "day" })
        ui.text #status(value="row {row} sorted {sortedBy} node {node} seen {seen}")
    }
}

ui.window(title="Data") {
    main()
}

func testARowIsSelected(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(win32.pickRow(c.status, 1))
    t.assert(c.row == 1)
    t.assert(c.picks == 1)
    t.assert(win32.clickColumn(c.status, 1))
    t.assert(c.sortedBy == "Age")
}

func testANodeIsSelected(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(win32.pickNode(c.status, "main.sngl"))
    t.assert(c.node == "main.sngl")
    t.assert(!win32.pickNode(c.status, "nowhere"))
}

func testADayIsPicked(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(win32.pickDate(c.status, "2024-03-05"))
    var d time.date = "2024-03-05"
    t.assert(c.day == d)
    t.assert(c.seen == "day")
    t.assert(win32.pickDate(c.status, ""))
    t.assert(c.day == null)
    t.assert(c.seen == "no day")
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.row = 0
    c.node = "src"
    var d time.date = "2024-03-05"
    c.day = d
    t.snapshot("data")
}
-- image.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import test "sngl:test"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"
import here "file:."

output {
    c {
        win32
    }
}

component main ui.node {
    var loads = 0
    var failure = ""
    var shown = false
    var clicks = 0
    ui.vbox {
        ui.image #logo(style={height=48px}, @load { loads += 1 }, @click { clicks += 1 }) {
            ui.file(path=here.path("logo.png"))
        }
        if shown {
            ui.image(@error(e) { failure = e.message }) {
                ui.file(path="missing.png")
            }
        }
        ui.button #show(text="show", @click { shown = true })
        draw.canvas(width=48px, height=48px) {
            draw.canvasImage(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=48.0, h=48.0) {
                ui.file(path=here.path("logo.png"))
            }
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    main()
}

func testAPictureLoads(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.wait(func() => c.loads == 1, 2000)
    t.assert(c.loads == 1)
    c.logo.click()
    t.assert(c.clicks == 1)
}

func testAMissingFileFails(t test.Test, c main) {
    c.show.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.failure != "", 2000)
    t.assert(c.failure == "the image could not be read")
}

func testDraws(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.wait(func() => c.loads == 1, 2000)
    t.snapshot("logo")
}

func testACanvasPaintsTheFile(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.wait(func() => c.loads == 1, 2000)
    t.snapshot("canvas")
}
